verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI capability in the pack is a single pricing-page line for 'AI product classification', which applies AI to the user's own product data to produce tax categorizations. The MCP server lets external agents (Claude, Cursor) answer questions about nexus and filings, but that AI runs in the user's own client, not inside Numeral, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or recommendations over sales, nexus or filing data; any detail on how AI classification suggestions are surfaced or reviewed; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
